column3: With respect to the Empire Mall Mortgage Loan (2.6%), the Mortgage Loan documents provide that the single-purpose entity borrower has personal liability for losses related to breaches of environmental covenants; however, for so long as Simon Property Group, L.P. is the non-recourse carveout guarantor, the non-recourse carveout guarantor’s liability is limited to 20% of the original principal amount of the related Whole Loan, plus all reasonable out-of-pocket costs and expenses (including court costs and fees and reasonable attorneys’ fees) incurred in the enforcement of the guaranty or preservation of the lender’s rights under the guaranty.
